name: 2V-R8 (Hunter)
description: 2V-R8, also known as Twovee Areight, was a Seneschal-series factotum droid owned by the bounty hunter who became the Grand Champion of the Great Hunt. Assigned to Hunter's D5-Mantis Patrol Craft when it was stolen by the bounty hunter in 3643 BBY, 2V-R8 was responsible for maintaining the starship and ensuring that its crew remained comfortable.
